limitations: Probe captures/renders one formula before the sidecar starts; full automatic recognition/rendering lifecycle remains to be built.
Research renderer uses installed Node.js and headless Chrome; packaging them or an alternative offline engine is not verified.
100 ms polling leaves a stale-frame interval; immediate invalidation and timeout behavior remain engineering gates.
One transient COMException occurred during synthetic UI changes; probe hid and then recovered.
Opaque theme only; UIA did not provide a numeric font size in this version.
Terminal focus/menus/tab changes and overlapping windows need explicit invalidation rules.
Mouse drag integration remains inconclusive; native hit-testing alone is insufficient proof.
No new model response was requested; streaming and live approvals require later verification.
